title: React Hooks: useMemo vs useCallback
question_text: Which hook should be used to memoize a function definition to prevent unnecessary re-renders of child components?
explanation: useCallback returns a memoized version of the callback that only changes if one of the dependencies has changed.

title: Javascript: Event Loop
question_text: In the Javascript Event Loop, where are Promises (resolved/rejected) handled?
explanation: Promises follow the microtask pattern and are executed after the current task and before the next task in the event loop.

title: Node.js: Streams
question_text: Which type of stream is used to both read and write data?
explanation: Duplex streams are streams that implement both the Readable and Writable interfaces.

title: Git: Rebase vs Merge
question_text: Which command integrates changes from one branch into another by rewriting the commit history to be linear?
explanation: git rebase moves or combines a sequence of commits to a new base commit, resulting in a cleaner, linear history.

title: React: Virtual DOM
question_text: What is the primary benefit of the Virtual DOM in React?
options: It makes the application run directly in the GPU
It reduces the number of direct manipulations to the real DOM
It eliminates the need for CSS
answer: It reduces the number of direct manipulations to the real DOM
explanation: React uses the Virtual DOM to compute the minimal set of changes needed and applies them to the real DOM in a single batch efficiency.

title: Reasoning: Blood Relations
question_text: Pointing to a photograph of a boy Suresh said, 'He is the son of the only son of my mother.' How is Suresh related to that boy?
explanation: Only son of my mother is 'Suresh' himself. So the boy is his son.
